description: Colombo Municipal Council - Notifying that the Supplementary Budget of the Colombo Municipal Council for the Year 2016 will be open for Public inspection from 09.12.2016 to 16.12.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the public inspection period for a municipal council's supplementary budget. This falls under public sector administration and financial procedures of a local government body, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a central government personnel or structural matter.
